undo-subtraction.name: Undo subtraction
undo-subtraction.when: A number is subtracted from x.
steps: Add that number to both sides.
Simplify to leave x.
undo-subtraction.check: Substitute the answer into the original equation; evaluate each side separately and check equality.

undo-addition.name: Undo addition
undo-addition.when: A number is added to x.
steps: Subtract that number from both sides.
Simplify to leave x.
undo-addition.check: Substitute the answer into the original equation; evaluate each side separately and check equality.

undo-multiplication.name: Undo multiplication
steps: Divide both sides by the coefficient.

undo-division.name: Undo division

undo-division.check: Substitute the answer into the original equation; evaluate each side separately and check equality.
